name: Plot Sampling
description: Turn an AOI polygon (a layer or a drawn sketch) into a grid of coded field plots in UTM metres: rectangular or circular plots, paths, nested sub-plots, standard designs (SNI 7724, Winrock, ICRAF, IHMB, CIFOR) and sample sizes from sampling intensity, Slovin, Cochran or the CDM A/R tool, with stratification and hatch styling.
author: Defani Arman Alfitriansyah
